title: 4521-MOM-LOI-039-062-0001-GAR Rev03 Performance Test Procedure
summary:
- Document describes performance testing procedure for Oil to Salt heat exchangers.
- ASME PTC 12.5-2000 and MS-HTF HEX Warranty Annex COMMENTED are referenced.
- Calculation method based on ASME PTC 12.5 predicts performance values.
- Stakeholders must agree on testing responsible, reference conditions, etc.
- Data from DCS is used for performance test monitoring.
- Known damages and fouling conditions are identified before the Test.
- Inspections include calibration, preliminary tests, and final performance test.
- Client is responsible for the test execution while Lointek handles analysis and report issuance.
- Four out of six variables are measured to calculate the remaining two based on ASME PTC 12.5.
- Five reference conditions (Cases 1-5) are defined for different scenarios.
- Heat exchangers must operate at steady state conditions for at least 15 minutes before testing.
- Fouling coefficient is initially set but may be reviewed based on direct observation and stakeholder agreement.
summary_points: Document describes performance testing procedure for Oil to Salt heat exchangers.
ASME PTC 12.5-2000 and MS-HTF HEX Warranty Annex COMMENTED are referenced.
Calculation method based on ASME PTC 12.5 predicts performance values.
Stakeholders must agree on testing responsible, reference conditions, etc.
Data from DCS is used for performance test monitoring.
Known damages and fouling conditions are identified before the Test.
Inspections include calibration, preliminary tests, and final performance test.
Client is responsible for the test execution while Lointek handles analysis and report issuance.
Four out of six variables are measured to calculate the remaining two based on ASME PTC 12.5.
Five reference conditions (Cases 1-5) are defined for different scenarios.
Heat exchangers must operate at steady state conditions for at least 15 minutes before testing.
Fouling coefficient is initially set but may be reviewed based on direct observation and stakeholder agreement.
Instruments installed during assembly are used to calculate the performance of the exchanger.
Accuracy requirements include Flow ± 5%, Temperature ± 3.69 ºF, Pressure ± 0.3 %.
Include a plane of the tubesheet for plugged tubes in Annex A.
Review overall dimensions, lagging placement, number of plugged tubes, cleaning of surfaces, and instrument placement before final performance test.
Install thermometers, manometers, and mass flow meters at inlet and outlet of hot and cold fluids.
Perform measures during steady state conditions for at least 15 minutes with 15 measurements every 2 minutes for 30 minutes.
